description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended) Issuance of certificate of exemption to persons to exempt from the requirement of obtaining a Licence for distributing electricity
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Public Utilities Commission issuing certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution to various private companies (77 Development (Pvt) Ltd, Ekroma Realtors (Pvt) Ltd, Colombo City Centre Partners (Pvt) Ltd). This falls under commercial regulatory matters involving business permits and exemptions for commercial entities, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6).
